senses.en: a laborer who moves from place to place as demanded by employment
senses.zh: 劳动者因就业需要而异地流动;

senses.en: a member of a people with dark skin and hair who speak Romany and who traditionally live by seasonal work and fortunetelling; they are believed to have originated in northern India but now are living on all continents (but mostly in Europe, North Africa, and North America)
senses.zh: 皮肤和头发黑的民族的成员,会说罗姆语,传统上靠季节性工作和算命;据信他们起源于印度北部,但现在生活在各大洲(但大多在欧洲、北非和北美).
